name: object_mesh_draw
evidence: args:a0=0x8008a63c object data, a2=0x00c09030 packed color/attr
rationale: Per-object 3D mesh transform + draw for dynamic objects: both object-render dispatchers (dirt_object_dispatch, scene_geometry_draw_dispatcher) call it; it builds rotation+translation matrices and perspective-transforms the object's mesh (SetRotMatrix/SetTransMatrix/RotTransPers). Largest resident unknown (9756 B); runtime-confirmed drawing objects in bee.sav (absent in the terrain-only ramp view).

name: results_screen_render
rationale: Draws the level-results / HUD screen: composites sprite tiles + glyphs (hud_draw_sprite_tile, hud_draw_glyph, result_draw_glyph_dim), uploads animation frames (result_upload_anim_frame) and plays sounds. The result_* callees are specific to the results screen.
